changelog:
Initial release of Photo Analyzer skill:

- Analyzes uploaded photos for key aspects such as exposure, focus, composition, and lighting.
- Provides detailed feedback and suggestions on camera settings (ISO, shutter speed, aperture, white balance) and shooting techniques.
- Offers actionable tips for post-processing to improve images.
- Can generate a simulated improved version of the photo based on recommended adjustments.
summary: Analyzes an uploaded photograph, provides detailed feedback on exposure, focus, composition, lighting, and suggests concrete camera settings and shooting technique. Generates a simulated improved image based on the recommendations.
